Important: `ipaddress.IPv6Address('2001:db8::1%eth0')` is ACCEPTED in Python 3.11 (scope id support was added in 3.9). So I must explicitly reject '%' — my charset filter handles that. Good thing I planned that.

Let me check `IPv6Address('2001:db8::1%eth0').scope_id` etc. And int() ignores the scope. So the charset prefilter is essential.

Now let me benchmark parsing and formatting speed.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import ipaddress, time, json
N=200000
addrs=['2001:db8:%x:%x::%d'%(i%65536,(i*7)%65536,i%256) for i in range(N)]
t=time.time()
vals=[int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(a)) for a in addrs]
print('parse ipaddress', time.time()-t)
CH=frozenset('0123456789abcdefABCDEF:.')
t=time.time()
out=[]
for a in addrs:
    if CH.issuperset(a) and len(a)<=45:
        try: out.append(int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(a)))
        except ValueError: out.append(None)
print('parse filtered', time.time()-t)
t=time.time()
s=[str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(v)) for v in vals]
print('format', time.time()-t)
t=time.time()
lines=[json.dumps({'probe_id':'w/s/0/low-1/0','received_ms':1000+i,'target':addrs[i],'source':addrs[i],'type':129,'code':0}) for i in range(N)]
print('gen rows', time.time()-t, len(lines[0]))
def uo(pairs):
    r={}
    for k,v in pairs:
        if k in r: raise ValueError('dup')
        r[k]=v
    return r
t=time.time()
for l in lines: json.loads(l, object_pairs_hook=uo)
print('json loads hook', time.time()-t)
t=time.time()
for l in lines: json.loads(l)
print('json loads plain', time.time()-t)
"
